scope: Noncontact body GetUp request/resource/sequence graph persistence and readmission foundation
invariants: Actor-local identities share one retained allocation frontier and are independent of combat contact IDs.
Primary, secondary and two fixed retired positions preserve absence; requests may share a single sequence identity.
Resources retain selected IDLE, actor base/model, authored KF path and exact hash.
Sequences retain manager membership, Start progress, inactive state, timing sentinels, retirement and captured pose tracks/destination.
Resident slot0, group2 cache and process sequence references are distinct and validated.
Restore never advances a clock, fabricates a request from schema71 resource ownership, reruns IDLE conditions or draws RNG.

World admission reacquires every retained resource with winning model/bank/KF checks; attached sequences require matching-key SpecialIdle group2 clamp2 metadata. Loaded ready resources may lack playable metadata.
Resource-only ready transaction rejects an existing graph before mutating raw state, RNG or selected resource. Combined ownership replacement remains a separate integration.
open: Natural creation and atomic replacement of the graph through resource/request transactions.
Actual World/renderer start, shared sequence updates, cache/action cleanup and graph projection on restore.
Loaded-resource identity reconciliation for future acquisitions after restore; do not infer identity solely from path/hash.
Natural recovery dispatcher and physical caller prefixes, including actual Player view policy.
Remaining M15S4 normal-input, device/view/FPS, audio and canonical full-save restart gates.
serialization_fixtures: Synthetic graph states test the fork format and identity semantics; their timing does not assert an original-game frame course.
